nameEn: Manufacture of made-up textile articles, except apparel
description: This class includes the manufacture of made-up textile articles of any textile material, except apparel.
includes: manufacture of blankets and travelling rugs
manufacture of bed linen, table linen, toilet linen and kitchen linen
manufacture of curtains, drapes and interior blinds
manufacture of tarpaulins, tents, camping goods: sleeping bags, camp furniture
manufacture of life-jackets and similar safety equipment
manufacture of stuffed quilts, eiderdowns, cushions, pouffes, pillows
excludes: manufacture of blankets of paper, see 1709
manufacture of carpets and rugs, see 1393
